description: This file is a TypeScript source code for a script that converts Asana project data into a board and block structure, likely for a project management or visualization tool. It includes functions for reading input files, processing project and section data, creating boards, cards, and views, and exporting the data.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: Represents a board object in the project management structure.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a block element such as a view or text block.

classes.name: IPropertyOption
classes.description: Interface for property options used in board properties.

classes.name: IPropertyTemplate
classes.description: Interface for property templates used in board configuration.

classes.name: Asana
classes.description: Interface or class representing the Asana project data structure.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.description: Interface or class representing a workspace or project within Asana data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, reads input, converts data, and writes output.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Extracts unique projects from the Asana input data.

methods.name: getSections
methods.description: Retrieves sections (columns) for a specific project from the Asana data.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts Asana data into board and block structures for export.

methods.name: showHelp
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.
